name: Why is my new garbage disposal leaking after installation?

mainEntity.name: Why is my new garbage disposal leaking after installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: If a new garbage disposal is leaking, it's often due to an improper seal during installation or a loose connection. Common leak points include the drainpipe connections, the dishwasher inlet plug, or the sink flange seal. This points to a need for process clarity, as professional installation includes meticulous checking of all connections and seals to prevent such issues. If you notice a leak, it's best to turn off the power to the unit and contact a professional immediately.
acceptedAnswer.description: Leaks after new disposal installation are usually due to improper seals or loose connections, like at drainpipes or the sink flange. Contact a professional immediately if you see a leak.
